title: Source-traceable continuous morphology of selected Voynich writing: frozen evidence contribution
description: A source-derived, class-free continuous contour/morphology representation of selected confirmed writing, retaining uncertain whole-parent extents and alternative raster recoveries. Includes the earlier structural/sequence/feature experiments and their negative results. Not a transcription or decipherment.
